name: Mori Nozomi
address: 11500 W. Pico Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90064

menus.name: Dinner Omakase at the sushi bar
menus.note: 22 to 25 courses, all seated at the counter and served together, so arrive on time; dishes cannot be changed or substituted

bookingOpens: Online on Tock only, for one to three guests, with a $280 deposit per guest held on the card and refunded within five to seven working days after the meal. Tables currently show to the end of next month.
cancellation: Cancel at least 96 hours ahead to avoid a charge. Between 48 and 96 hours ahead, 50% of the menu price plus tax and a 2% transaction fee is charged; within 48 hours, and for no-shows, the full $280 per guest plus tax and the fee. Bookings cannot be changed within 48 hours.
waitlist: Tock's waiting list is open for full dates.
byob: Corkage is $100 per 750ml bottle of wine or champagne and $150 per bottle of sake, not allowed for anything the restaurant sells.
